title: Safe Social Presence: Microsoft Teams
source: ICT Grade 3 (Nile International) Block 1 Week 3 Study sheet pp.14-16, Classwork, Homework

scenes.t: Microsoft Teams is a tool that helps you connect with others and have online discussions, in a safe and secure place.
Sign up means creating a new account for the first time. You type your email and follow the steps on the screen.
At school, we use our school account. To sign in, you enter your school account, press Next, then enter your password and press Sign in.
Then click the App Launcher, and choose Teams. Now you can use Microsoft Teams!
When you finish, always sign out. Click your profile picture, and choose Sign out. This keeps your account safe.
Online risks are dangers on the internet, like identity theft, scams, cyberbullying, harmful content, and losing your private data.
Never click on unknown links, never share your password, and never accept friend requests from strangers.

items.a: Creating a new account for the first time.
Leaving your account when you finish, to keep it safe.
A safe and secure platform used for school discussions.
A danger on the internet, like cyberbullying or unknown links.
